page.content:
1 September 1939 — the start of the European war.

How Invasion of Poland connects

  • Faction: Nazi Germany — Germany's invasion of Poland opened the European war.
  • Topic: World War II — The Polish campaign is the conventional start of the world war in Europe.

What is Invasion of Poland?

Germany's invasion of Poland, joined by the Soviet Union from the east, ended the interwar pause. Britain and France declared war on Germany two days later.

Key threads lead to Nazi Germany and World War II.
